scenes.text: Multiples appear when you count by a number. The least common multiple is the first shared positive multiple.
Find LCM(8, 6). The answer is 24. Least common multiple equals 24.
Two bells at a market stall ring every 4 and 10 minutes. After how many minutes will they ring together? Pause the video and think.
Two bells at a market stall ring every 4 and 10 minutes. After how many minutes will they ring together? The answer is 20. Least common multiple equals 20.
